relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings demonstrated that SNI caused a downregulation in SIRT1 expression in glutaminergic neurons of the hippocampal CA1 area.

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of PSD95 in the hippocampus was markedly reduced

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: In SNI mice, overexpression of SIRT1 in glutamatergic neurons in the hippocampal CA1 region or increased SIRT1 enzyme activity could significantly improve the harm to hippocampal synaptic plasticity and the cognitive dysfunction caused by chronic pain.

relationships.subject: SRT1720
relationships.evidence_quote: The findings demonstrated that SRT1720 counteracted the reduction in SIRT1 expression levels induced by SNI

key_findings: SNI downregulates SIRT1 in hippocampal CA1 glutamatergic neurons, impairing synaptic plasticity and context fear memory.
SIRT1 knockdown mimics, and SIRT1 overexpression or SRT1720 rescues, the deficits without changing pain threshold.
